newsitem.title: USA: Nalco Chemical Co Q4 net up.
newsitem.headline: Nalco Chemical Co Q4 net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 earnings from continuing operations of $40.4 million or $0.56 a share primary and $0.52 fully diluted.
Q4 1996 results also include income from discontinued operations of $2.8 million or $0.04 primary and $0.03 fully diluted.

Q4 1995 results include income from continuing operations of $34.9 million or $0.48 a share primary and $0.45 fully diluted, and income from discontinued operations of $3.4 million or $0.05 a share primary and $0.04 fully diluted.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include income from continuing operations of $145.9 million or $1.99 a share primary and $1.86 a share fully diluted, and income from discontinued operations of $8.6 million or $0.13 a share primary and $0.11 fully diluted.

Full-year 1995 results include income from continuing operations of $135.7 million or $1.83 a share primary and $1.71 fully diluted, and income from discontinued operations of $18.0 million or $0.27 a share primary and $0.24 fully diluted.
